Prefix(:=<http://example.org/diff004#>)
Ontology(<http://example.org/diff004>
  SubObjectPropertyOf(:r :s)
  TransitiveObjectProperty(:s)
  InverseObjectProperties(:u :v)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:r :a :b)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:s :b :c)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:u :a :d)
)
rationale: SHI reasoning: r⊑s plus a r b entails a s b; s is transitive so a s b and b s c entail a s c. InverseObjectProperties(u,v) means u ≡ v⁻, so u(a,d) entails v(d,a). r is not transitive, so a r c is NOT entailed (a r b and b r c — there is no b r c); u(b,c) is not entailed since no u-edge from b. Profile verdicts: EL rejects InverseObjectProperties; QL rejects TransitiveObjectProperty; RL allows both; DL/Full allow both.
